Masoor & Sweet Potato Rolls

Now with this roll, you don’t have to worry about ensuring your kids get their dose of required nutrition.

5 minPreparation
10 minCooking
2Servings

Ingredients

For 2 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Heat the oil in a pan and add the cumin seeds. When they crackle, add the onions and sauté till they turn semi-transparent.
  2. Add the green chillies and ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
  3. Add the mashed sweet potato, boiled red lentils, chaat masala, coriander and salt, and sauté for 2 to 3 minutes.
  4. Add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and mix well. Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions.
  5. Place a portion of hot spicy potato and lentil filling in the centre of each chapatti and roll up lightly.
  6. Place the rolls on a hot griddle (tawa) and cook using a little oil, till the rolls turn golden brown.
